name: @migaki/codex
description: Codex lifecycle hook adapter for Migaki execution observations.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path='dist/hook.js'; fs.writeFileSync(path, fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8').replaceAll('from \"@migaki/runtime\"','from \"../../runtime/dist/execution.js\"'));"
